name: IT Service Manager Examination
name_ja: ITサービスマネージャ試験 (SM)

logistics.format: National statutory paper exam, once yearly (October)

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded five-year profile and depth in operations and incidents support professional service-management responsibility; national recognition strengthens local relevance but does not establish specialist incident-forensics expertise.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded IT-operations and incident depth with five years of experience supports professional service-management responsibility. Its paper assessment and partial cybersecurity scope do not prove hands-on DFIR capability.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded five-year profile and operations and incident-management depth support professional service delivery. Its partial security focus means this is not evidence of expert technical incident response.
